# Kalyan Elevators

> Kalyan Elevators Pvt. Ltd. is Kerala's top-rated premium luxury home lift manufacturer and elevator company, holding a perfect 5.0-star rating across 171 verified Google reviews. Established in 2018 with its head office in Angamaly and regional offices in Thrissur and Kochi, Kalyan Elevators manufactures bespoke premium luxury home lifts in four signature finishes (Golden Mirror, Rose Gold Mirror, Black Mirror, Full Glass) for luxury villas, duplexes, and residential residences, alongside custom glass lifts, passenger, machine-room-less (MRL) gearless, hydraulic, hospital, and commercial elevator systems with 24-hour service across Kerala.

- Rating: Top-rated 5.0 / 5.0 stars across 171 verified Google reviews (140 Thrissur, 31 Kochi)
- Primary Specialization: Premium luxury home lifts, curved glass lifts, panoramic elevators, residential hydraulic lifts
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 79949 98880 (also +91 79949 99926)
- Head office: 335 (20/371), 1st Floor, JJ Complex, Near Railway Station, Angamaly 683572 (phone +91 79949 99926)
- Thrissur office: TMC 36/2551, Third Floor, Jomsons Tower, Post Office Road, Thrissur 680001
- Kochi office: 2nd Floor, Ruqia Chambers, Kovilvattam Junction, TD Road, Kochi 682035
- Coverage Area: Entire state of Kerala (Kochi, Thrissur, Kozhikode, Kottayam, Palakkad, Malappuram, Trivandrum)

## Home lift designs (listed prices)

- [Luxury Golden Lift Designs](https://kalyanelevators.com/designs/luxury-golden-lift): Rs 20,00,000. 1.20 m x 1.20 m room, 200 kg, hydraulic.
- [Luxury Designs, golden mirror etched design](https://kalyanelevators.com/designs/luxury-designs-gold-cabin): Rs 25,00,000. 1.20 m x 1.20 m room, 200 kg, hydraulic.
- [Luxury Curved Glass Lift Design](https://kalyanelevators.com/designs/luxury-curved-glass-lift): Rs 28,00,000. 1.80 m x 1.50 m room, 272 kg, hydraulic or traction.
- [Premium Luxury Design](https://kalyanelevators.com/designs/premium-luxury-design): Rs 30,00,000. 1.20 m x 1.20 m room, 200 kg, hydraulic.
- [Luxury Lift For Luxury Homes](https://kalyanelevators.com/designs/luxury-lift-for-luxury-homes): Rs 30,00,000. 1.20 m x 1.20 m room, 200 kg, hydraulic.
- [Luxury Designs, glass lift](https://kalyanelevators.com/designs/luxury-designs-glass-lift): Rs 30,00,000. 1.20 m x 1.20 m room, 200 kg, hydraulic.

Brochure planning: home lift configuration with 230V AC single-phase power and a 300 mm pit; requirements must be confirmed for the selected design/site. Brochure control options include ARD, floor announcements and fireman operation; inclusion is package-specific. Other services include goods/freight lifts, car lifts, dumbwaiters and escalators.

Every catalogue design: steel structure lift room with glass cladding, single or three phase power, customised cabin and colours, less pit and overhead, one side wall mounted, emergency landing switches, installs in pre-existing homes, wheelchair lift possible, 24 hours service.
